english.title: Use a laden motor vehicle on a road with a lateral projection exceeding 4.3 metres
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), carrying a load so that the overall width of the vehicle together with the width of

(A)_[a lateral projection]_
(B)_[the lateral projections]_

of its load exceeded 4.3 metres
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) See offence wordings: H2552, H2553 and H3057 for width of laden vehicle exceeding 2.9 metres.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H2549 and H2550.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
